Anus, haemorrhoid, haemorrhoidectomy

Received in formalin is a piece of haemorrhoidal tissue, measuring 1.5 x 1 x 0.8 cm. The cut surface shows dilated vessels within the stroma. Representative sections in 1 block.

(1) Haemorrhoid, representative sections.

Sections show anal squamous mucosa. Ectatic muscular blood vessels are noted in the stroma. The features are those of haemorrhoid. There is no evidence of dysplasia or malignancy.

ANUS, haemorrhoid, haemorrhoidectomy - HAEMORRHOID
